$comment: Authoritative decision-case table for scripts/port-tick/liveness.mjs's classifyUnmatched. Per plugins/port/docs/PIPELINE.md → 'Liveness': at most one automatic reset per item per session, and only when this session's own dispatch log records the item.

cases.name: no dispatch-log row at all — report-only forever
first unmatched tick after a fresh dispatch — debounce to suspect
still unmatched after suspect, never reset — safe to reset
already reset once and stalled again — capped, never reset twice
